subject: Request: One-time pilot bridge + term variance for Starlite AI
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@starlite.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short extension + credit top-up request (Starlite POC)

Hi Stephanie,

Quick note from our side — the ingestion hiccup last week set our evaluation back by about 2 weeks. The team is still very positive about the results but we need a short runway to complete the benchmarks across our 6 largest intents. Can Redwood do a one-time top-up of credits and a 30-day extension to the current pilot window?

What would help: 1) +75k token credit to finish the benchmark runs, 2) 30 extra days on the trial, and 3) a short addendum to the order form documenting the extension. We don't want a full new contract; just a one-time bridge to finish the POC.

Attaching a short summary of what remains. Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Thanks,
Oliver
Director of ML, Starlite AI
--Attachment: POC_summary_Starlite.pdf (PDF, 420KB)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@starlite.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short extension + credit top-up request (Starlite POC)

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear ask and the summary. I'm sorry to hear about the ingestion issue; glad things are otherwise trending positive.

I'm looping in Aditya (sales ops) and Laura (VP Revenue) to approve a one-time credit and short extension. Proposed quick solution from our side:
- One-time top-up: 75k token credit applied to the existing pilot account
- Trial extension: +30 days to the current end date
- Contract: short addendum (no MSA changes) and an updated order form for signature

If Laura or Aditya need financials or a cost delta, I've attached the hubspot deal and the rough estimate below. If we can get exec sign-off today we can push the order-form out tomorrow and send the DocuSign link.

Proposed condition: Starlite agrees to a pilot-to-paid milestone (commit to a paid POC or production trial within 60 days of extension to take advantage of a 10% first-month credit/discount). If that sounds unreasonable we'll note alternatives.

Aditya / Laura — please advise if this one-time variance is approvable and whether legal needs to touch the addendum. Happy to provide the usage logs and the POC plan from the engineering team.

Best,
Stephanie
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short extension + credit top-up request (Starlite POC)

Thanks Steph — I reviewed the usage and cost projection. A one-time 75k token credit is within our discretionary pilot fund, but the 30-day extension combined with the credit shifts runway assumptions. Two quick asks before I greenlight:
1) Confirm expected incremental cost to Redwood (see attached estimate).
2) Confirm the milestone language — we should be explicit about the tie to conversion or paid pilot within 60 days to avoid open-ended extensions.

If both are clear I can approve the credit allocation. For any SLA or contract changes beyond the order form addendum, loop in Legal.

--Attachment: deal_commodities_estimate.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)

Aditya
Head of Commercial Ops
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short extension + credit top-up request (Starlite POC)

I approve a one-time grant of 75,000 token-equivalent credits and a 30-day bridge extension for Starlite AI under the following conditions:
- Credit and extension are a single one-off concession. No automatic renewals.
- Addendum will state: 75,000 token credit applied; pilot end date +30 days; conversion milestone (paid pilot or purchase order) required within 60 days of the new end date.
- Offer a 10% discount on the first paid month only if Starlite signs an order within the 60-day window.
- Finance to confirm revenue recognition treatment; copy Finance on the order form.
- Legal only needs to review the addendum if Starlite requests changes to the MSA; otherwise an order-form addendum is sufficient.

Karthik/Dev: please prepare the updated order form and a DocuSign envelope. Aditya: finalize the internal cost note so we have a record. Stephanie: confirm with the customer and get the go-ahead to send the DocuSign link.

Laura Bennett
VP Revenue, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@starlite.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short extension + credit top-up request (Starlite POC)

Oliver — good news: leadership approved the one-time bridge. Summary of what we approved and next steps:

What we approved:
- One-time credit: 75,000 token-equivalent credit applied to your current pilot account
- Extension: +30 calendar days to the existing pilot end date
- Conditional incentive: 10% first-month discount if you sign an order within 60 days of the new end date

Next steps:
1) I'll send an updated order-form addendum via DocuSign (no MSA edits expected). Please review and sign to formalize the extension. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/abcdef-12345
2) Engineering will re-run the remaining benchmarks once you confirm ingestion is resolved; we can coordinate a short sync mid-week if helpful.
3) We'll apply the credit as soon as the signed addendum is complete.

Attachment: updated_order_form_draft.pdf (PDF, 85KB)

Thanks for your patience — we'll get your team the runway to finish the evaluation.

Best,
Stephanie
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
